podcast.body: The Stone Roses performed this song on "Top of the Pops" on November 23, 1989, on the same show as Happy Mondays. In that same week, "Fools Gold" climbed to number eight on the National Singles Charts, marking the highest chart position for an indie song in a significant period and signaling Manchester's arrival on the national stage. "And they performed Fools Gold. And that week, that song went to number eight on the National Singles Charts, the highest charting indie song in ages."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track is considered one of The Stone Roses' finest works, showcasing the dance groove established by Reni on drums and Mani on bass. Released in 1989, it embodies the band's distinctive sound. "From 1989, the Stone Roses with Fools Gold."
